'''icebreath Abyssins''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 24 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed MKOS icebreath DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The title says it all.  An old-skool Abyssin swarm deck that should bring back some pleasant (or not-so-pleasant) memories.

== Strategy ==

This one should be pretty easy to figure out... drop Abyssins, battle, drop more Abyssins, battle, wash, rinse, repeat.  Cards like Imperial Propaganda, No Escape, None Shall Pass, and Wounded Wookiee throw your opponent off-guard more often than they'd like.  Abyssin Ornament, Scum And Villainy, Jabba's Twerps, and the flipside of your objective give you some pretty heavy retrieval.

Serious, folks, it's not hard to understand.  It's a simple alien swarm deck... nothing fancy about it at all.  >:)

Enjoy... I know I have.

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
